archetypes.name: step5-recovery-contract
archetypes.rationale: The change crosses Python review gating, Bash bgjob recovery, and prompt-facing wrapper contracts.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review whether the plan preserves the distinction between threshold failure and archetype coverage. Check that cached stall envs relaunch without breaking live bgjob rejoin or valid final stall routing. Verify that docs and harnesses pin the new recovery behavior without changing MAV or main-agent handoff branches. Cite the exact files, functions, and test names that support each finding. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
